verses.text: لِىَ انْقَادَ مِمَّنْ بِالَّذِى رُمْتُهُ مَنَّا
verses.transcription: liyan qaada mimman bil lazii rumtuhu mannaa

verses.text: كِتَابٌ عَزِيزٌ ذَبَّ ضُرِّى لَدُنْ عَنَّا
verses.transcription: kitaabun haziizun zabba durrii ladun hannaa

verses.text: يُبَشِّرُنِى بَاقٍ أُنَاجِيهِ وَحَمْدَهُ
verses.transcription: yubash-shirunii baaqin unaajiihi wa hamdahu

verses.text: بِذِكْرٍ حَكِيمٍ جَآبِهِ مُرْسَلٌ سَنَّا
verses.transcription: bizikrin hakiimin jaabihi mursalun sannaa

verses.text: مَحَا اللَّهُ مُذْ بِالْفَيْضِ مَعْ رَوْضِهِ حَبَا
verses.transcription: mahal laahu muz bil faydi mah rawdihi habaa

verses.text: مُكَا بَدَتِى الشَّيْطَنَ وَالِانْسَ وَالْجِنَّا
verses.transcription: mukaa badatish shaytana wa linsa wal jinnaa

verses.text: إِلَى مَنْ لَّهُ كُلِّيَّتِى قَدْ تَوَجَّهَتْ
verses.transcription: ilaa man lahu kulliyyatii qad tawajjahat

verses.text: مِدَادِى وَأَقْلَامِى وَقَدْ كَانَ لِى مَنَّا
verses.transcription: midaadii wa aqlaamii wa qad kaana lii mannaa

verses.text: يَقُودُ عُلُومَ الْغَيْبِ رَبِّى مُعَلِّمِى
verses.transcription: yaquudu huluumal ghaybi rabbii muhallimii

verses.text: إِلَى كَلْكَلِى فَيْضًا يُرِى اللَّفْظَ وَالْمَعْنَى
verses.transcription: ilaa kalkalii faydan yuril lafza wal mahnaa

verses.text: شُهُورِى وَأَعْوَامِى غَدَتْ خَيْرَ طَاعَةٍ
verses.transcription: shuhuurii wa ahwaamii ghadat khayra taahatin

verses.text: لِّمَنْ بِتَوَا لِيفِى هَدَا مَنْ بِهَا يُعْنَى
verses.transcription: liman bitawaa liifii hadaa man bihaa yuhnaa

verses.text: تُوَصِّلُ أَقْلَامِى إِلَى اللَّهِ عَابِدًا
verses.transcription: tuwassilu aqlaamii ilal laahi haabidan

verses.text: بِلَا خَلْوَةٍ وَاللَّهُ أَبْقَى كَمَآ أَغْنَى
verses.transcription: bilaa khalwatin wal laahu abqaa kamaa aghnaa

verses.text: هَدِيَّاتُ رَبِّى قَادَتِ الْأَجْرَ وَالرِّضَى
verses.transcription: hadiyyaatu rabbii qaadatil ajra war ridaa

verses.text: إِلَيْنَا كَمَا قَدْ كَّيَّبَ الْعُمْرَ وَالْمَغْنَى
verses.transcription: ilaynaa kamaa qad kayyabal humra wal maghnaa

verses.text: وَعَيْتُ عُلُومًا نَّافِعَاتٍ بِلَفْظِ كُنْ
verses.transcription: wa haytu huluuman naafihaatin bilafzi kun

verses.text: وَلِى قَادَ رَبِّى خَيْرَ زَيْدٍ عَنِ الْحُسْنَا
verses.transcription: wa lii qaada rabbii khayra zaydin hanil husnaa

verses.text: نَفَى مَالِكِى مَاسآئَنِى قَبْلَ رُؤْيَةٍ
verses.transcription: nafaa maalikii maasaa-anii qabla ru-yatin

verses.text: وَصِرْتُ لَهُ عَبْدًا خَدِيمًا لِّذِى الْأَسْنَا
verses.transcription: wa sirtu lahu habdan khadiiman lizil asnaa

verses.text: بَدَا لِىَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ لَارَبَّ غَيْرَهُ
verses.transcription: badaa liya annal laaha laa rabba ghayrahu

verses.text: وَأَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَاقَ الْوَرَى حُسْنَا
verses.transcription: wa anna rasuulal laahi faaqal waraa husnaa

verses.text: كَتَبْتُ وَإِنِّى شَاكِرٌ لَّسْتُ ذَا اشْتِكَآ
verses.transcription: katabtu wa innii shaakirun lastu zash tikaa

verses.text: وَعَنِّى مَحَامَا سَآئَنِى اللَّهُ إِذْ عَنَّا
verses.transcription: wa hannii mahaa maa saa-anil laahu iz hanaaa

bayts.text: لِىَ انْقَادَ مِمَّنْ بِالَّذِى رُمْتُهُ مَنَّا ۞ كِتَابٌ عَزِيزٌ ذَبَّ ضُرِّى لَدُنْ عَنَّا

translations.it.karamati: Mi si è sottomesso, da parte di Colui che mi ha favorito di ciò che desideravo, un Libro possente che ha respinto il mio danno quando si è presentato.
translations.en.karamati: There has yielded to me, from Him Who favoured me with what I sought, a mighty Book that repelled my harm when it appeared.
translations.fr.karamati: S'est soumis à moi, de la part de Celui qui m'a gratifié de ce que je désirais, un Livre puissant qui a repoussé mon mal quand il s'est présenté.

bayts.text: يُبَشِّرُنِى بَاقٍ أُنَاجِيهِ وَحَمْدَهُ ۞ بِذِكْرٍ حَكِيمٍ جَآبِهِ مُرْسَلٌ سَنَّا

translations.it.karamati: Mi annuncia la buona novella un Permanente che invoco in intimità – e la Sua lode – con un Ricordo saggio recato da un Inviato che ha stabilito la Sunna.
translations.en.karamati: An Everlasting One I call on intimately – and His praise – gives me glad tidings, with a wise Remembrance brought by a Messenger who laid down the Sunna.
translations.fr.karamati: M'annonce la bonne nouvelle un Permanent que j'invoque intimement – et Sa louange – par un Rappel sage apporté par un Envoyé qui a établi la Sunna.

bayts.text: مَحَا اللَّهُ مُذْ بِالْفَيْضِ مَعْ رَوْضِهِ حَبَا ۞ مُكَا بَدَتِى الشَّيْطَنَ وَالِانْسَ وَالْجِنَّا

translations.it.karamati: Allah, da quando mi ha donato l'effusione insieme al Suo giardino, ha cancellato il mio patire Satana, gli uomini e i jinn.
translations.en.karamati: Allah, since He granted me the outpouring together with His garden, has erased my suffering from Satan, men and jinn.
translations.fr.karamati: Allah, depuis qu'Il m'a donné l'effusion avec Son jardin, a effacé ma souffrance de Satan, des hommes et des djinns.

bayts.text: إِلَى مَنْ لَّهُ كُلِّيَّتِى قَدْ تَوَجَّهَتْ ۞ مِدَادِى وَأَقْلَامِى وَقَدْ كَانَ لِى مَنَّا

translations.it.karamati: Verso colui al quale tutto il mio essere si è volto, (si sono volti) il mio inchiostro e le mie penne; ed Egli è stato per me un benefattore.
translations.en.karamati: Toward him to whom all my being has turned, (have turned) my ink and my pens; and He has been a benefactor to me.
translations.fr.karamati: Vers celui vers qui tout mon être s'est tourné, (se sont tournées) mon encre et mes plumes ; et Il a été pour moi un bienfaiteur.

bayts.text: يَقُودُ عُلُومَ الْغَيْبِ رَبِّى مُعَلِّمِى ۞ إِلَى كَلْكَلِى فَيْضًا يُرِى اللَّفْظَ وَالْمَعْنَى

translations.it.karamati: Il mio Signore, mio Maestro, conduce le scienze dell'invisibile al mio petto, in un'effusione che mostra la lettera e il senso.
translations.en.karamati: My Lord, my Teacher, leads the sciences of the unseen to my breast, in an outpouring that shows the word and the meaning.
translations.fr.karamati: Mon Seigneur, mon Maître, conduit les sciences de l'invisible vers ma poitrine, en une effusion qui montre la lettre et le sens.

bayts.text: شُهُورِى وَأَعْوَامِى غَدَتْ خَيْرَ طَاعَةٍ ۞ لِّمَنْ بِتَوَا لِيفِى هَدَا مَنْ بِهَا يُعْنَى

translations.it.karamati: I miei mesi e i miei anni sono divenuti il miglior atto d'obbedienza per Colui che con le mie opere ha guidato chi se ne occupa.
translations.en.karamati: My months and my years have become the best obedience for Him Who through my works has guided whoever attends to them.
translations.fr.karamati: Mes mois et mes années sont devenus le meilleur acte d'obéissance pour Celui qui par mes ouvrages a guidé qui s'en occupe.

bayts.text: تُوَصِّلُ أَقْلَامِى إِلَى اللَّهِ عَابِدًا ۞ بِلَا خَلْوَةٍ وَاللَّهُ أَبْقَى كَمَآ أَغْنَى

translations.it.karamati: Le mie penne fanno giungere ad Allah un adoratore, senza ritiro (khalwa); e Allah ha fatto permanere come ha arricchito.
translations.en.karamati: My pens bring a worshipper to Allah, without seclusion (khalwa); and Allah has made abide as He has enriched.
translations.fr.karamati: Mes plumes font parvenir à Allah un adorateur, sans retraite (khalwa) ; et Allah a fait demeurer comme Il a enrichi.

bayts.text: هَدِيَّاتُ رَبِّى قَادَتِ الْأَجْرَ وَالرِّضَى ۞ إِلَيْنَا كَمَا قَدْ كَّيَّبَ الْعُمْرَ وَالْمَغْنَى

translations.it.karamati: I doni del mio Signore hanno condotto a noi la ricompensa e il compiacimento, così come Egli ha reso buoni la vita e la dimora.
translations.en.karamati: The gifts of my Lord have led reward and good pleasure to us, just as He has made life and dwelling good.
translations.fr.karamati: Les dons de mon Seigneur nous ont amené la récompense et l'agrément, de même qu'Il a rendu bonnes la vie et la demeure.

bayts.text: وَعَيْتُ عُلُومًا نَّافِعَاتٍ بِلَفْظِ كُنْ ۞ وَلِى قَادَ رَبِّى خَيْرَ زَيْدٍ عَنِ الْحُسْنَا

translations.it.karamati: Ho appreso scienze giovevoli con la parola «Sii!», e il mio Signore mi ha condotto il migliore accrescimento oltre il bene più bello (Corano 10:26).
translations.en.karamati: I have taken in beneficial sciences by the word "Be!", and my Lord has led to me the best increase beyond the finest good (Qurʾān 10:26).
translations.fr.karamati: J'ai acquis des sciences profitables par la parole « Sois ! », et mon Seigneur m'a amené le meilleur surcroît au-delà du plus beau bien (Coran 10:26).

bayts.text: نَفَى مَالِكِى مَاسآئَنِى قَبْلَ رُؤْيَةٍ ۞ وَصِرْتُ لَهُ عَبْدًا خَدِيمًا لِّذِى الْأَسْنَا

translations.it.karamati: Il mio Padrone ha respinto ciò che mi affliggeva prima che lo vedessi, e sono divenuto Suo servo, servitore di colui che possiede i più alti splendori.
translations.en.karamati: My Master repelled what afflicted me before I saw it, and I became His servant, the servant of the possessor of the highest splendours.
translations.fr.karamati: Mon Maître a repoussé ce qui m'affligeait avant que je ne le voie, et je suis devenu Son serviteur, serviteur de celui qui possède les plus hautes splendeurs.

bayts.text: بَدَا لِىَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ لَارَبَّ غَيْرَهُ ۞ وَأَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَاقَ الْوَرَى حُسْنَا

translations.it.karamati: Mi è divenuto chiaro che Allah: non vi è signore all'infuori di Lui, e che l'Inviato di Allah ha superato le creature in bellezza.
translations.en.karamati: It has become clear to me that Allah: there is no lord besides Him, and that the Messenger of Allah has surpassed creation in beauty.
translations.fr.karamati: Il m'est devenu clair qu'Allah : il n'est de seigneur que Lui, et que l'Envoyé d'Allah a surpassé les créatures en beauté.

bayts.text: كَتَبْتُ وَإِنِّى شَاكِرٌ لَّسْتُ ذَا اشْتِكَآ ۞ وَعَنِّى مَحَامَا سَآئَنِى اللَّهُ إِذْ عَنَّا

translations.it.karamati: Ho scritto, e io sono riconoscente, non lamentoso: e Allah ha cancellato da me ciò che mi affliggeva quando si è presentato.
translations.en.karamati: I have written, and I am grateful, not complaining: and Allah has erased from me what afflicted me when it appeared.
translations.fr.karamati: J'ai écrit, et je suis reconnaissant, non plaintif : et Allah a effacé de moi ce qui m'affligeait quand cela s'est présenté.
